notes:
Summary: Lumos builds customer self-service plus agent assist for mid-size e-com brands. Primary ask is automated ticket/email summarization and auto-tagging into Zendesk/Freshdesk workflows. Wants macros that populate suggested responses and can trigger backend tool-calls (refunds, order lookup).

Details / constraints:
- Workload: mostly ticket/email bodies (1-3 paragraphs) + attachments metadata. Also agent chat assistant for escalations.
- Latency: tagging/classification must be <500ms for inline macros; full abstractive summary OK up to 1.5s.
- Throughput: baseline 2k-3k tickets/day, peak 6k-8k/day with holiday spikes (estimated 8k RPM peak during campaigns).
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for Dedicated if it guarantees SLA & predictable unit economics.
- Model preferences: open to distilled LLMs + quantized variants; want ability to route to cheaper variant for bulk categorization, fallback to higher-quality model for summaries where confidence low.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to a higher-latency but higher-quality endpoint for tickets flagged as "sensitive" or legal.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logging for model inputs/outputs, KMS integration for keys, clear data residency commitments.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "Agents want one-click suggested replies; they should be editable, not pushed." (Support Ops Director)
- "If tagging lags, macros break our routing rules — we need stable sub-second classification."

Integration notes:
- Primary CRMs: Zendesk currently (sandbox account provided), investigating Freshdesk for smaller clients.
- Wants a Redwood connector that can call their internal refund service via secure tool-calling / webhook.

POC plan (current):
- Week 0: Connect Redwood hosted endpoint to Zendesk sandbox, basic tagging + summary flow (sample 1k tickets).
- Week 1: Measure latency p95/p99, iterate on batching & cache settings.
- Week 2: Simulated spike test (8k RPM) and security sign-off.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Do we support Zendesk app store packaging or only API-based integrations?
- Can you enforce region pinning for inference + logs?
- Recommended quantization profile for classification vs abstractive summary?

Stubs & refs: Fireflies ff-20260214-317 (security kickoff), Gmail thread:1832bqh9 (pricing follow-ups), drive:/deals/lumos/poc-plan-v1.pdf (POC SOW).

Sales notes: strong technical champion (Platform Director), procurement timeline tied to Q2 budget cycle. Risk if spike SLA not demonstrable in POC.
requirements:
- Inline auto-tagging <500ms p95; abstractive summarization <1.5s p95.
- Support Zendesk/Freshdesk macros and webhook tool-calls.
- Audit logs for all model inputs/outputs; KMS key control.
- Option for Dedicated capacity or VPC-hosted control plane.
- Routing policies: cost-first for low-confidence -> escalate to high-quality model.
- Acceptance test: simulate 8k RPM spike for 10 minutes with <2% error rate and no dropped requests.
short_description: Mid-market CS automation vendor evaluating Redwood for ticket/email summarization + sub-second auto-tagging into Zendesk/Freshdesk; POC planned for Apr; main concerns are spike reliability, data residency, and Zendesk app packaging.
